text:
Lestijärvi is hardest hit, 189 road km from Jyväskylä, with 16 nights away for 15 breast sessions versus 6 for 5 [S60, S59].

1. The head of radiotherapy could evaluate a single 8 Gy session as default for uncomplicated painful bone metastases, with equal pain relief but more retreatment [S31, S30]. Lestijärvi's expected nights away are 6.2 with the multi-fraction course versus 2.4 with a single 8 Gy session [S60]. Within 30 days, the clinical team reviews which cases count as uncomplicated [S31]. It serves the Goal 3 indicator "Patients receive treatment within target times" [S24].

2. The breast lead could evaluate 5 sessions as default for eligible patients (whole breast or chest wall without nodal radiotherapy), naming distance as a reason, as it is non-inferior [S9, S15, S14]. Yearly, the county would avoid 202 nights away and free 202 machine sessions (calculated, breast cancer alone) [S33, S57, S34, S35, S60]. Within 30 days, the clinical team reviews eligibility and distance as a reason [S15]. It serves the Goal 3 indicator "Patients receive treatment within target times" [S25].

3. The cancer services analyst could evaluate yearly reporting of schedule mix and radiotherapy use by distance band [S16]. Within 30 days, the analyst and the clinical team decide which figures to report [S16]. It serves the Goal 3 indicator "Regional differences in treatment are available and used to steer services (cross-cutting indicator)" [S26].

Distances use municipality centre points, and the current schedule mix is unknown [S59, S60, S16].
